reason: The lines show an authenticated POST to the Azure DevOps commit search API using a bearer token, then returning the response text, so they support SECRET because SaaS data reached with credentials is brought into the agent context. The returned commit search API response is external repository/search content and can include attacker-controlled commit data, supporting UNTRUSTED. The request is to a fixed Azure DevOps vendor endpoint rather than an agent-chosen attacker-readable destination, so SINK is not supported. No arbitrary host code execution is shown.
